description: This Dart source file defines a centralized application router for a Flutter app. It manages named routes, generates route widgets, and provides a stub screen for navigation testing. The file also defines route name constants, emphasizes routing logic, and includes navigation helpers.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Centralized class managing app route names and route generation logic.

classes.name: _StubScreen
classes.description: A placeholder screen widget used to verify routing paths within the app.

classes.name: _NavButton
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a navigation button to a specified route.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Generates a route based on the route name in settings, returning the appropriate screen widget.

methods.name: _StubScreen.build
methods.description: Builds the placeholder UI with route info and navigation options.

methods.name: _NavButton.build
methods.description: Builds an ElevatedButton that navigates to a specified route when pressed.
